## POST `/api/2.29/subnets`

**Tier:** T1+ (check: some POSTs are actions)  

Create an array subnet.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `X-Request-ID` | header | string |  | Supplied by client during request or generated by server. |
| `names` | query | array of string | yes | A comma-separated list of resource names. |

**Request body** (required): `Subnet`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | string (read-only) | A non-modifiable, globally unique ID chosen by the system. |
| `name` | string (read-only) | Name of the object (e.g., a file system or snapshot). |
| `enabled` | boolean (read-only) | Indicates if subnet is enabled (`true`) or disabled (`false`). If not specified, defaults to `true`. |
| `gateway` | string | The IPv4 or IPv6 address of the gateway through which the specified subnet is to communicate with the network. |
| `interfaces` | array of `_fixedReference` (read-only) | List of network interfaces associated with this subnet. |
| `link_aggregation_group` | `_reference` | Reference to the associated LAG. |
| `mtu` | integer (int32) | Maximum message transfer unit (packet) size for the subnet in bytes. MTU setting cannot exceed the MTU of the corresponding physical interface. If not specified, defaults to `1500`. |
| `prefix` | string | The IPv4 or IPv6 address to be associated with the specified subnet. |
| `services` | array of string (read-only) | The services provided by this subnet, as inherited from all of its interfaces. |
| `vlan` | integer (int32) | VLAN ID. |

**Responses:** `200` OK → `SubnetResponse`
